definitions.gloss: discharge from military service; leaving the armed forces
definitions.explanation: The act of being released or dismissed from military duty. Used for both voluntary and involuntary separation from the military.

examples.japanese: {兵役|へいえき}を{終|お}えて{除隊|じょたい}した。
examples.english: He was discharged after completing his military service.

examples.japanese: {除隊|じょたい}{後|ご}、{彼|かれ}は{故郷|こきょう}に{戻|もど}った。
examples.english: After his discharge, he returned to his hometown.

examples.japanese: {怪我|けが}のため{名誉|めいよ}{除隊|じょたい}となった。
examples.english: He received an honorable discharge due to injury.

notes:
Composed of {除|じょ} (to remove, to exclude) + {隊|たい} (unit, troop). The opposite of {入隊|にゅうたい} (enlisting). In modern Japan, this word appears mainly in historical contexts (WWII narratives) and in discussions of other countries' militaries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {除隊|じょたい}する: to be discharged from the military
- {除隊|じょたい}{後|ご}: after discharge
- {名誉|めいよ}{除隊|じょたい}: honorable discharge
- {除隊|じょたい}{届|とどけ}: discharge papers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入隊|にゅうたい}: enlisting — the opposite: joining the military
- {退役|たいえき}: retirement from military service — implies a longer career ending
- {復員|ふくいん}: demobilization — specifically returning home after wartime service
